skill.name: imagen
skill.description: Guides AI image generation with Google Gemini for UI placeholders, documentation visuals, and design assets.
skill.summary: Create Gemini image prompts and PNG assets for interface, documentation, and design workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The audit found mostly false positives from Markdown backticks and example blocks, not executable Ruby or shell interpolation. One command example is security-relevant because it invokes a relative Python script that is not bundled, and the skill requires GEMINI_API_KEY for a Google Gemini workflow.

remediation.issue: Relative script path is documented but not bundled.
remediation.suggestion: Include the generate_image.py script in the skill package or replace command examples with instructions that locate a trusted bundled script path.

remediation.issue: Secret environment variable is required for image generation.
remediation.suggestion: Document how GEMINI_API_KEY is read, never log it, and require user confirmation before sending prompts or credentials to Google Gemini.

remediation.issue: External Gemini API use is described without a privacy boundary.
remediation.suggestion: State that prompts are sent to Google Gemini and advise users not to include sensitive text in image prompts.

content.value_statement: Teams often need visual assets before a designer can deliver final artwork. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create Gemini image prompts and save PNG assets.
actual_capabilities: Guides text-to-image requests using Google Gemini image generation.
Provides command examples for basic prompts, output paths, and 2K size requests.
Supports frontend placeholders, documentation visuals, icons, logos, and UI asset concepts.
Documents the GEMINI_API_KEY and Python 3.6 or newer requirements.
Describes PNG output behavior and expected success or failure messages.
limitations: The referenced generate_image.py script is not included in this package.
Image generation depends on Google Gemini access and a valid GEMINI_API_KEY.
Generated images may need manual review for quality, rights, and brand fit.
The documented model name and API behavior may change over time.

use_cases.title: Create Interface Placeholders
use_cases.description: Generate temporary hero images, avatars, and product visuals while frontend layouts are still being built.

use_cases.title: Illustrate Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Create simple concept images or architecture visuals for README files, guides, and internal documentation.

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Directions
use_cases.description: Draft image concepts for icons, logos, and design assets before requesting final production artwork.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Image Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need a simple generated image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a PNG image of [subject] with [style], [mood], and [background]. Save it in the current project folder.

prompt_templates.title: Frontend Placeholder Asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a UI needs temporary visual content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a placeholder image for a [component] in a [product type] interface. Match the layout size, tone, and color direction.

prompt_templates.title: Documentation Illustration
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when written documentation needs a visual aid.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a clear illustration that explains [technical concept]. Keep the image simple, readable, and suitable for documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Production Asset Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need stronger art direction and file placement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a polished [asset type] for [audience] using [brand attributes]. Save it to [path] and explain any review concerns.

output_examples.input: Request a hero image for a developer tools landing page.
output_examples.output: A saved PNG path with an abstract technology image concept suitable for a first-page hero section.

output_examples.input: Ask for a microservices documentation diagram.
output_examples.output: A documentation-ready visual concept that shows services, communication flow, and deployment boundaries.

output_examples.input: Request a placeholder avatar for a profile component.
output_examples.output: A square PNG asset designed for profile UI testing and layout review.

best_practices: Confirm the output path before generating files inside a repository.
Use clear prompts that state subject, style, size, and intended placement.
Review generated images for privacy, licensing, accessibility, and brand fit.
anti_patterns: Do not include secrets, private customer data, or confidential plans in prompts.
Do not assume generated art is approved for production without review.
Do not run a relative script path unless you have verified the script source.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It guides generation of PNG images for UI placeholders, documentation, icons, logos, and design concepts.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the package include the image script?
faq.answer: No. The package only includes SKILL.md, so users must verify any referenced script before running it.

faq.question: What credential is required?
faq.answer: The skill requires a GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable for the Google Gemini image workflow.

faq.question: Can I use generated images in production?
faq.answer: Use them only after review for quality, rights, accessibility, and brand requirements.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The documentation says images are saved as PNG files, with a default location in the current directory.
